parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost. <short pause> Romans, chapter fifteen, verse thirteen.

God of hope, fill me tonight with the joy and peace that come from trusting You. <short pause> Let hope overflow in my heart by the power of Your Holy Spirit. <short pause> I quiet my anxious thoughts and receive the rest You offer to those who believe. <short pause> Amen.
